reviews.x: I love this product! I am a heavy smoker and 41. My teeth are big and have been looking dingy and yellow lately no matter what tooth paste I used. After day 3 of twice daily use my teeth were noticeably whiter. The yellow film started to fade and i have no sensitivity. I have a spot on my front tooth that has never whitened with the other products  and it's not there anymore. Also I have used different pens to help whitened my teeth in past and they all made my teeth sensitive and hurt to where

reviews.t: Can see the difference after a couple uses!
reviews.x: Definitely can see a difference after 2 uses - affordable and I like the pen better than strips. Would recommend!
Hands down best affordable and convenient teeth whitening solution. Results can be seen within couple days and it tastes better than other similar products. Very good product 👌

I’ve been using this whithening pen, which is way cheaper than the strips and i can definetely say it works, you can notice the difference since the first use, i'll definetely keep using it to maintain my teeth white, it surely changes the way you look.

This product is awesome. I have used 1/2 of the stick and I see my teeth whitening. I had a cap put in on my upper tooth and it didn't match the tooth next to it. After using the stick for one week I saw a distinctive match to the capped tooth. Every time I use it the teeth get whiter. I will continue to use it twice a day forever.
I used it as directed, but my teeth are still white yellow. Quite disappointed because other reviews emphasized that it works.

reviews.t: RESULTS VISIBLE AFTER FIRST COUPLE OF USES!
reviews.x: I was able to notice a difference after just a couple of uses! I continued to apply the gel to my teeth for 2 and a half weeks (and I suggest doing so for best results). Another great perk of this specific product is how easy it was to use. Many other teeth whitening products that I saw on Amazon were complicated, or simply ineffective according to the reviews. But this one goes above and beyond, and you can very easily notice your teeth get whiter over time. There were also no sensitivity issue

reviews.t: This works in hard to reach places.
reviews.x: OK the flavor is not a midnight snack, but it is worth it. In-between teeth was a problem with trays but with the pen, I put it directly where I need it. Personally I apply it, use a floss to maneuver it even more, leave on for a good half hour with my mouth open to not remove product from tooth then rinse it off and wipe tooth area with a hand towel as a gentle polish. I am getting compliments and feel great. Very excited. Takes some days for deeper stains but be patient and it WILL work.

reviews.t: Amazing product and I definitely recommend it to anyone wanting to brighten up smile .
reviews.x: This is an amazing product and the price was amazing as well . I have been using the whitening pen for 2 weeks and I can see at least 4 shades whiter than before . Thank you Teeth Whiting pen !

reviews.t: So easy to use! Great for getting the crevices
reviews.x: My teen daughter recently had braces off and she wasn't a fan of the difference in color between where the brackets had been for years and the rest.  I first got her the teeth whitening kit with the mouthguard looking thing and the LED light.  It worked well, but she wanted something she could just brush on and leave vs sitting there with stuff all in her mouth.  She actually really likes the brush because she felt she could get in between and up around the edges better because she could control

I’ve used other so called “whitening pens” that do very little to whiten your teeth and almost gave up.  Then I tried this one and saw immediate result and continue to each time I use it.  It takes 30 min, which is no problem, and you’re teeth are noticeably whiter.  I use it about once a week and continue to see improvement.  Best I’ve tried!
So easy to use. My teeth are so much whiter !! Thank you . I will buy again and definitely gift to friends

I am not getting paid to write this review. I hardly ever write product reviews but for this one I just have to. Maybe it will help someone out. This pen is THE BEST teeth whitening I have ever used. I have used the crest and it doesn't even compare. This pen works super fast im not exaggerating that. The first night I used it within first application I could see a huge difference and my teeth was yellow like pee color yellow from ciggeretes coffee ect. I have tried everything and nothing worked

I have  tried several other brands that was awful tasting and didn’t give me the whiting quality that this one does, I’m happy with my purchase and will by more again when I’m out, if you’re looking for a whitener that is easy to use this one is great instruction is easy to follow not messy I gave it a 5 star  I even got one for my grand daughter and she love it too she’s happy with her results as well her teeth was dull now they are much brighter since she’s been using it It really does Whiten

I have tried multiple different brands of the same type of product and I must say, this one has been the most effective of all! It was so easy to use from the start and I really loved that it doesn't have a bad flavor when in my mouth...so that is truly awesome :) I started seeing results almost immediately and today my teeth are in a much better place than they did. Please try this product, you will not regret!

This teeth whitening pen is very easy to use, just click the bottom of the pen to dispense the whitening liquid up to the application brush. Unfortunately, I have only been using it for a week and don't see too much improvement yet. However, despite the short period of use I am starting to see my teeth whiten. I am hopeful that this product will continue to produce the results it has advertised.

reviews.t: These pens are convenient and work well!
reviews.x: I bought this pack to share with my son. He's been using one and I have used the other. It is very convenient to apply the gel quickly and results seem to be fast. We've both noticed whitening within a few days and are happy with the product! For the price, they are well worth it and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them. Also, no sensitivity which is really nice!

I only saw my teeth whiter for the first few days slightly but barely.  They do not work. Waste of money I still have the other pen that has not been open but I don't bother to use it. The first pen is halfway used but I don't even use it because it's pointless. Which I had my money back.

Whitens your teeth.  Easy to use. I like brush on better since you can get in on your teeth evenly unlike the strips. I made a mistake when i ordered this and customer service when above and beyond to sort out the problem that was totally my fault.

reviews.t: Good Stuff  and Easy To Apply
reviews.x: This gel works well if you use it as directed and is very easy to apply.  A prior retainer would be advantageous to use as well as a blue light for a nice white smile....but not necessary.  Much better than the gel and trays.  Give it a try!
I have sensitive teeth so I am always a little apprehensive about OTC teeth whitening.  Based on the reviews I decided  to purchase this product. I was not disappointed. The results are amazing.
This is the first whitening product I’ve used that has actually given results after the first application. Definitely a steal for the price. Will be adding to my Amazon subscription list 🖤
I see some whitening, but my dental hygienist was very impressed at how white my teeth were. They make my teeth slightly sensitive, but not as bad as crest white strips.
I’ve only used this pen twice now and I already see a difference! I’m excited to see how white I can get my teeth with continued use. I would buy again!

reviews.t: Works great and is very resonable in cost!
reviews.x: I picked this product because I did a searh to find the best whitening pen and this was #1.  It worked great and I will definately buy it again!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently report visible whitening results within just a few uses or days.
Users find the pen easy and convenient to use, often preferring it to strips or trays.
Many reviewers praise the product as affordable and good value compared to alternatives.
Several reviewers note the product has a pleasant or at least acceptable taste compared to other brands.
A minority report disappointment, including one reviewer who saw no whitening at all.
